Orion Pharma (Orion Corporation) develops, manufactures, and distributes
proprietary and generic human pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and animal health products
. Key proprietary and partnered brands include
Nubeqa
(darolutamide, partnered with Bayer),
Stalevo
and
Comtess/Comtan
(Parkinson's disease),
Simdax
and
Precedex
(critical care), and the
Easyhaler
pulmonary inhaler product line.
Orion Pharma
Key Proprietary and Partnered Brands
Nubeqa (darolutamide):
Prostate cancer treatment co-developed with
Bayer
Stalevo, Comtess, & Comtan:
Neurological medications for Parkinson’s disease.
Simdax & Precedex/Dexdor:
Intensive care and critical care sedatives and heart medications.
Easyhaler family:
Inhaler devices and formulations including Budesonide, Formoterol, and Salmeterol/Fluticasone for respiratory diseases.
Fareston (toremifene):
Hormone therapy used in oncology.
Orion Pharma
Distribution and Manufacturing Partnerships
Shilpa Medicare:
Partnered for commercializing an intravenous nivolumab biosimilar across European markets.
CuraTeQ Biologics (Aurobindo Pharma):
Collaborates on distributing biosimilars across Nordic and European countries.
Merck (MSD):
Co-development partner for advanced prostate and hormonal cancer treatments like Opevesostat (ODM-208).
Fermion:
Orion’s fully owned subsidiary that manufactures and supplies APIs both internally and externally to global pharmaceutical manufacturers.
